profile.summary: Univa Foods Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was involved in hotel operations, food products, trading, and distribution activities. The company was formerly known as Hotel Rugby Limited and changed its name to Univa Foods Limited in August 2022. Univa Foods Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
